resolved_gate.question: UNBOUNDED_SUPPORT_NECESSITY_VS_UNIVERSAL_BOUNDED_SUPPORT
resolved_gate.evidence: Fundamentum PR #298 constructs maxdef-critical shared-pivot families with minimum signed-transport support at least k for arbitrary k.
resolved_gate.evidence_substitution: Fundamentum PR #305 proves the same growing lower bound for many-to-one signed-literal substitutions.

critical_transport_chain.result: For every fixed K there exists a maxdef-critical sibling pair requiring signed-permutation transport support greater than K.
A strictly broader many-to-one signed-literal model transport gives an exact safe deletion on a critical pair with no signed-permutation transport.
Generic many-to-one signed-literal substitution discovery is NP-complete.
No universal fixed deviation-support K covers all maxdef-critical sibling pairs even for many-to-one literal substitutions.

An explicit maxdef-critical sibling pair admits no many-to-one signed-literal substitution transport in either direction. Scope note: one child has maxdef zero and is terminal under R44BD V2, so this is relation non-universality, not a both-nonterminal merge obstruction.

Many-to-one signed-literal substitution discovery remains NP-complete even when the siblings come from a promised maximum-deficiency-critical width-3 parent. The reduction uses Graph 3-Coloring -> universal-vertex 4-coloring -> private K4 forcing gadgets -> fixed K4 source.

Explicit binary equivalence backbones can be quotient-compressed polynomially before transport discovery; unbounded raw support need not remain unbounded after exact congruence quotienting. Residual becomes congruence-rigid.

Allowing Boolean constants 0/1 in the substitution relation is too expressive: for every satisfiable source B, such a transport B->A exists iff A is satisfiable. Discovery therefore contains ordinary SAT witness search.

discarded_as_universal_routes: unrestricted literal substitutions as a universally polynomial discovery mechanism
current_exact_frontier.remaining_target: Find a strictly broader safe-deletion relation whose certificates are polynomially verifiable, whose discovery does not trivially contain arbitrary SAT witness search, and whose exact quotient/restriction acts on congruence-rigid, maxdef-critical both-nonterminal siblings.
current_exact_frontier.admission_rule: Any new relation must prove sound model transport, polynomial certificate verification, polynomial discovery on its claimed class, strict rank movement or terminal dispatch, and explicit non-universal/counterexample boundaries.
